name: remote-upgrade-tracker
description: Check GitHub or GitLab for open dependency bump issues, pull requests, and branches to avoid duplicate work. Read-only.

inputs.name: enable-github
inputs.description: When true, search GitHub via gh when authenticated.

inputs.name: enable-gitlab
inputs.description: When true, search GitLab via glab or API when available.

inputs.name: custom-instructions
inputs.description: Optional owner/repo override or extra search keywords.

outputs.name: remote-collision-report
outputs.description: Markdown table of in-flight work with links and skip, supersede, or coordinate recommendations.
